Kerala ministers blame unscientific dumping for Wayanad landslide

Kerala ministers have stated that the recent landslide in Wayanad was a man-made disaster, caused by the unscientific dumping of excavated earth. Environmental groups have also raised concerns, holding the state government accountable and seeking the suspension of further tunnel works. They allege the tunnel project was approved with inadequate scientific evaluation, despite early warnings from environmentalists.
